column1: # ⚠ THE NINE WARNINGS EVERY MANUAL IN SCOPE EARNS, and they are furniture rather than
# findings -- they come from the three VENDORED GFDL macro files, not from this manual:
#   RawBlockSkipped 8   @tex blocks in common-macros.itexi (5), macros.itexi (1) and
#                       cyrillic.itexi (1) -- raw TeX, which this chain has no typesetter
#                       for and renders nothing for, by design. ⚠ The eighth belongs to
#                       whichever of the two @tex blocks in common-macros.itexi the manual
#                       reaches; every manual reaches the same set.
#   Macro           1   common-macros.itexi:330 defines @macro cindex over the built-in
#                       @cindex; the package keeps the built-in and says so.
# Anything ABOVE that floor is this manual's own, and is explained below.
# changes -- MEASURED at wave LD5 (2026-08-19) and READ before freezing.
# NOTHING above the floor. Thirteen snippets, all engraved; ten pages.
# ⚠ This is the ONE manual of the nine that includes no fdl.itexi and therefore carries no
# licence notice in its rendered output. The licence gate is written as a BICONDITIONAL for
# exactly that reason -- see CorpusManualRenderTests -- because a gate weakened to let this
# manual through would have stopped being a licence gate.
# ⚠ It also carries two Supplementary-Plane music symbols, U+1D134 and U+1D135. They are
# NOT text: both sit inside a @lilypond[quote] snippet and reach the reader as engraved
# music, which is why this manual's PDF drops nothing and needs no font decision.
